text: Peer Tutoring is a drop-in tutoring service offered to currently enrolled students in various math, chemistry, physics, and engineering courses. As a drop-in tutoring service, you do not need to schedule an appointment in advance; rather, you can simply show up to the tutoring lab any time we are open for some help. Our tutoring lab is located in the bottom floor of the McDermott Library in room MC 1.304. Check the schedules below to see which courses we offer tutoring for, what times tutoring is available for each course, and the number of tutors we have on for each course at any given time.
